description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineIpcClientMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineIpcClient' interface, used for testing media pipeline IPC client interactions in the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for various notification functions related to media playback, network state, QoS, and buffer underflow.
